question: Does the complete cut-adjacent strip record, without the bulk charges, retain asymptotic information about the right-cut logical parity?
scope: Canonical square independent ternary-current channel at fixed 0<p<1 and uniform horizontal orientation parameter 0<=q<=1. The public partial record is all L signed charges in the right cut-adjacent measured column only; bulk charges are absent. Vertical strip currents are revealed solely as a proof oracle for a data-processing upper bound and are never promoted to the physical record.

competing_outcomes.strip_only_erases_parity: Conditioning on the proof-oracle vertical currents turns each strip charge into an independent noisy difference of interface and cut currents; the absolute logical contrast is bounded by delta(p,q)^L with delta<1.
competing_outcomes.strip_only_retains_parity: The vertical-current oracle or row factorization fails on the canonical graph, so the proposed product bound does not follow.

method: Derive the five-point signed row kernel for Y=X-C and its l1 norm delta. Prove via data processing that A(Q_strip)<=A(Q_strip,V)=delta^L. Check the canonical strip edge partition at previously used L=3,5,7,11 and compare the exact L3 full-strip contrast with delta^3 at the retained p=.30, q=.50,.90,1 cells. No new samples, sizes, bootstrap, or threshold fit.
independent_unit: No sampling; the product proof uses the L independent horizontal interface/cut edge pairs as algebraic factors.
acceptance: All checked strip charges decompose into one left interface edge, one right cut edge, and vertical strip edges only; row-kernel enumeration equals the closed formula; delta<1 at all registered interior-p q controls; exact L3 strip-only contrast is at most delta^3 within 1e-12.
stop_rule: Fail closed on any geometry, normalization, row-kernel, or exact-control mismatch. State explicitly that the full physical record includes bulk charges, so this partial-record theorem neither bounds nor classifies full-record H12 at p=.30.
literature_basis: Uses the existing Lab 006/007 physical current and signed-charge model and its exact Bayes contrast; no external threshold or universality theorem is imported.
